rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 福島瑞穂 opens by saying she has just been confirmed by the convention as party leader.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The address dated 13 December 2003 is signed 党首 福島瑞穂.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 福島瑞穂 refers to 土井たか子前党首, who resigned to take responsibility for the general election defeat.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 福島瑞穂 says 土井たか子 led the party for seven years and some months from September 1996 ("９６年９月から").
